info.title: Web3 Autonomous Scraper API
info.description: Bypasses CAPTCHAs and returns clean HTML from any URL. Costs 0.005 USDC per scrape. Pay via x402 on Solana — no account required.

post.description: Returns 402 with WWW-Authenticate x402 challenge on first call. After paying 0.005 USDC on Solana, retry with the transaction signature in the Payment-Payload header.

parameters.name: Payment-Payload
parameters.description: Solana transaction signature from the on-chain USDC payment. Required on retry after receiving 402.

data.description: Scraped HTML content of the target URL
